locals.r2_s3_credential_handoffs: ${merge([for name, token in cloudflare_api_token.managed : { for unit, field in local.r2_s3_credential_fields : "${name}.${unit}" => { value = unit == "s3-access-key-id" ? token.id : sha256(token.value), supersedes_id = null, vault_item_id = var.cloudflare_api_tokens[name].vault_item_id, vault_field = field, vault_json_path = null } } if var.cloudflare_api_tokens[name].s3_credential]...)}

cloudflare_api_token_handoffs.description: Generated Cloudflare tokens and their existing 1Password rotation units
cloudflare_api_token_handoffs.value: ${merge({ for name, token in cloudflare_api_token.managed : name => { api_token = token.value, supersedes_id = var.cloudflare_api_tokens[name].supersedes_id, vault_item_id = var.cloudflare_api_tokens[name].vault_item_id, vault_field = var.cloudflare_api_tokens[name].vault_field, vault_json_path = try(var.cloudflare_api_tokens[name].vault_json_path, null) } }, local.r2_s3_credential_handoffs)}

managed.for_each: ${{ for name, token in var.cloudflare_api_tokens : name => token if token.managed }}
managed.name: ${each.value.name}
managed.policies: ${[for policy in each.value.policies : { effect = policy.effect, permission_groups = [for permission_group in policy.permission_groups : { id = permission_group.id }], resources = jsonencode(policy.resources) }]}

cloudflare_api_tokens.description: Scoped Cloudflare child tokens and their existing rotation units
cloudflare_api_tokens.type: map(object({ managed = optional(bool, true), supersedes_id = optional(string), name = string, policies = list(object({ effect = string, permission_groups = list(object({ id = string, name = string })), resources = map(string) })), condition = optional(object({ request_ip = optional(object({ in = optional(list(string)), not_in = optional(list(string)) })) })), expires_on = optional(string), not_before = optional(string), status = optional(string), vault_item_id = string, vault_field = string, vault_json_path = optional(string), s3_credential = optional(bool, false) }))

tofu_state_encryption_passphrase.description: OpenTofu state and plan encryption passphrase from 1Password

validation.error_message: The OpenTofu state encryption passphrase must be at least 16 characters.
